scoring_justification: Q_st and uptake are final simulation results; the only raw artifact (isotherm CSV) lacks host-guest energy data to recompute Q_st and the sandbox cannot rerun GCMC. Reference values from the paper's GCMC simulation are used with noise-tolerant tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference values for Q_st and CO2 uptake from the paper's GCMC simulation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'At zero coverage… interaction energy of 48.0 kJ mol⁻¹' and 'simulated CO2 uptake … 95 cm³ g⁻¹'
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's explicit statement of simulation results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual simulated values reported in the paper; no other hidden source exists.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing zero-coverage isosteric heat of adsorption (Q_st) in kJ/mol.

outputs.description: Zero-coverage isosteric heat of adsorption of CO2 in the expanded framework 1' at 298 K.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing CO2 uptake in cm³ (STP) per gram of framework at 298 K and 1 atm.

outputs.description: CO2 uptake from GCMC simulation at 298 K and 1 atm.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the two headline GCMC simulation results: zero-coverage Q_st and uptake at 1 atm. Both outputs are compared to hidden reference values from the paper with appropriate tolerances. All inputs (crystal structure, force fields, GCMC code) are public.
